newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK funds outpace competition with 26 pct returns.
newsitem.headline: HK funds outpace competition with 26 pct returns.

text.p: Hong Kong equity funds took the top slot in the Hong Kong Investment Funds Association's (HKIFA) performance table in September with an annual return of 26.28 percent, the association said on Monday.

"The robust (Hong Kong) performance in September may have been triggered off by the release of moderate economic figures in the U.S. and the decision by the U.S. Federal Reserve to leave interest rates unchanged," HKIFA chairman Andrew Lo said.
"Furthermore, the recovery in the local property sector and signs that consumer spending is picking up again further help to boost investment sentiment," he said.
Hong Kong equity funds have stayed in the top five positions in terms of annual returns in all three quarters this year, placing third overall with an annual return of 20.76 percent.

North American equity funds were the only other sector that came close to staying in the top five throughout the first nine months of this year, attaining a top-five performance for each month so far this year except for August.
